name: replace_text
description: Replace exact occurrences of `old` with `new` in a file (read-modify-write). Refuses if `old` is empty or absent. count = number of replacements (default 1; -1 = all). Writes to disk, so it requires approval.

old.description: Exact substring to find (must not be empty).

new.description: Replacement text (may be empty to delete).

count.description: Number of occurrences to replace (default 1; -1 = all).
